This is a third-party question-bank dataset, not an official RU-hosted original-paper scan. The site's data-correct-answer values are candidate keys and are kept unverified; no official RU key was independently checked. Exam rules are intentionally omitted rather than inferred from the practice-bank configuration. Retained question text has not been independently cross-checked against the original printed paper; contentVerificationStatus is unverified. All provided keys remain unverified candidates. Curated Science-core export contains 90 records from the source variant; 9 records labelled outside the core subject set are held in a separate review ledger. The official/current subject scope must not be assumed to prove every historical page variant; confirm each old session against an original source before promoting any record.
